summary: Joe Lonsdale, a Peter Thiel protégé, co-founded Palantir in 2004, then Addepar and OpenGov, and the venture firms Formation 8 and 8VC, which he moved to Austin in 2020. An active Republican donor and fundraiser, he helped lead Elon Musk's pro-Trump America PAC in 2024, backs the pro-AI super PAC Leading the Future, invested in Palmer Luckey's Erebor bank, and hosted a JD Vance fundraiser in Austin in 2026. He also founded the Cicero Institute and co-founded the University of Austin.
